units: Semantic endpoint 'Causal Permeability' is not resolved in this repository to an immutable corpus/repository object identifier.
No repository-wide operational estimator is given for reachable adaptive mechanism space mathcal G or Delta mathcal G.
Independent operational criterion for genuine/unlimited open-ended novelty is not specified.
mathcal G is conceptually defined but no generally valid observable representation or estimator is specified.
Extraction of Omega from reality and criterion for constraint relevance are not operationally identified.
Arrow Omega->Delta mathcal G is a causal claim without a specified estimator/intervention scheme in the formal definition.
Causal Permeability is source-related but not resolved to an immutable corpus endpoint.
The 'transition/phase transition' wording has no quantitative threshold or order parameter defined.
No general metric establishes when reachable possibility space has changed rather than merely being relabeled.
Causal Permeability endpoint identity is not resolved.
Criterion that a task truly requires a new representation/search/learning mechanism rather than more optimization within an existing mechanism is unspecified.
M_e=|Delta mathcal G| lacks definition of mechanism identity, equivalence classes, cardinality under continuous spaces, and estimator.
C_residual and deletion-test capability have no task-normalized measurement protocol or causal attribution rule.
Compute, information, parameter count, exploration budget and intervention-equivalence controls are not fully specified in this document.
No sample-size, uncertainty, statistical decision, preregistration or effect-size protocol is specified.
Adaptation, transfer, mechanism transition, recovery and dependency metrics are proposed without validated construct mapping or common scales.
The design does not fully specify how additional information/flexibility is separated from causal-mechanism access as the treatment.
Proposed multiple learning-strategy creation/switching experiment is not directly implemented by the frozen source modules.
Source explicitly states mathcal G is not directly observable.
Derivative partial mathcal G_(t+1)/partial Omega_t is not given an operational perturbation, representation or estimator.
Measurable causal contribution of Omega to Delta mathcal G is required but no identification strategy is specified.
Genuine open-ended adaptation/novelty is not independently operationalized, creating potential circularity with the CTC definition.
No estimator, uncertainty model, sample-size or decision threshold is supplied.
This file calls CTC 'Constraint Transition Condition' while repository title uses 'Causal Transition Condition'; relationship is not explicitly explained.
Planned modules agent.py/mechanism_space.py/ctc_controller.py/experiment.py do not correspond one-to-one to frozen implementation, which consolidates primitives in ctc_core.py and simulator.py.
Evaluation metrics are named but measurement validity/normalization is not established.
Cross-field mappings are conceptual/source-authored and do not establish exhaustive literature coverage or empirical superiority.
P_t, A_s, M_e, transfer and dependency are proposed without validation/calibration.
mathcal G is represented conceptually as mechanism space but no generally justified finite representation is specified.

Evolution log calls the evolving framework 'Constraint–Trajectory Coupling (CTC)' whereas repository/current docs use 'Causal Transition Condition'; same-acronym nomenclature relation is source-historical but not formally reconciled.
P(X|you) versus P(X|not you) is counterfactual notation without intervention semantics, nearest-world definition or estimator.
Reported conceptual result has no frozen execution artifact, external test transcript, independent replication or measurement protocol beyond the narrative description.
ClosedAdaptiveAgent and PermeableAdaptiveAgent are imported from src.ctc_core but are not defined in the frozen ctc_core.py.
calculate_permeability_score and calculate_adaptation_score are imported from src.metrics but frozen metrics.py defines differently named functions.
Environment(difficulty=10) conflicts with frozen Environment dataclass requiring state:EnvironmentState.
Closed and permeable simulators share the same mutable Environment object and run sequentially; equivalence/independence is not established.
Runtime text 'Observed: E* -> C_rev' is generated from comparison of permeability scores, not from an independently identified causal-effect estimator.
Hard-coded positive example histories/metrics have no execution provenance and are explicitly example data, not observed results.
Hard-coded permeable-outperformance series are explicitly placeholder sample data, not experimental results.

novelty_rate, constraint_strength, dynamic_environment, agent permeability/learning/exploration settings, many metric flags, save flags, and generate_plots are not consumed by run_from_config.py/run_trial in the frozen code.
random_seed 42 is configured but run_from_config.py does not apply it, and runner-local benchmark uses random.choice without seeding.
YAML specifies 100x500 while run_ctc_benchmark.py has independent DEFAULT_CONFIG 20x100; only config runner consumes YAML scale.
Environment(difficulty=...) conflicts with current required state argument.
Closed and permeable simulations share one mutable environment sequentially; controlled equivalence is not established.
Random difficulty selection has no seed application in this runner.
Docstring calls executed target the 'Causal Permeability Principle benchmark' while module/file names call it CTC; relation is not explicitly formalized.
Only trials, steps, difficulty_levels and output.directory are consumed; most YAML treatment/environment/metric/output options do not affect execution.
Requirements file labels project 'Causal Permeability Principle' rather than Causal Transition Condition; identity/relation not explicitly resolved.
results/, figures/, *.csv and *.json are ignored by policy, so current-head absence of generated artifacts cannot identify whether execution occurred elsewhere or locally without commit.
Frozen module does not define ClosedAdaptiveAgent or PermeableAdaptiveAgent expected by example/runner imports.
AdaptiveAgent requires controller and has no capability, mechanisms or result attributes/method expected by tests and simulator-facing subclasses.
Base adapt delegates to controller and returns None, while CTCSimulator.step expects a result with capability and mechanisms.
measure_permeability returns treatment switch itself (1 iff permeability_active), so it does not independently measure causal influence.

When treatment is active, mechanism expansion is directly generated as adapt_to_<constraint.source>; relation between this deterministic treatment-coded expansion and genuine reachable mechanism-space growth is unvalidated.
Environment requires state:EnvironmentState, conflicting with examples/tests/runners constructing Environment(difficulty=...).
step appends the mutable self.state object then mutates its timestep; historical snapshots are not copied, so history entries can alias the same evolving object.
permeability_score equals treatment assignment rather than observed causal permeability.
Integer list-size difference operationalizes Delta mathcal G without validation that string-count equals reachable adaptive mechanism-space expansion.
Residual ratio is arithmetic over supplied values; no removal protocol or causal attribution is implemented in the metric itself.
Threshold .5 for high/low dependency is uncalibrated and input semantics are supplied externally.
Composite multiplies heterogeneous proxies and labels >.5 strong causal permeability without scale validation or threshold calibration.
Frozen metrics module lacks calculate_adaptation_score and calculate_permeability_score imported by examples/runners.
CTCSimulator.step expects agent.adapt result.capability/result.mechanisms, conflicting with current base AdaptiveAgent.adapt returning None.
evaluate_agent synthesizes after_removal as 0.5*current capability and dependency inputs 0.5/0.5 rather than measuring removal/dependency from simulation.
evaluate_agent uses only last history entry's mechanism_expansion as growth, not total/cumulative reachable-space change.
run_first_experiment/run_comparison can use one mutable environment sequentially for baseline and CTC simulations; independent environmental trajectories are not enforced.
ClosedAgent/PermeableAgent inherit AdaptiveAgent but are instantiated with no required controller and expect missing capability/mechanisms/result members.
Tests treat size as attribute while frozen AdaptiveMechanismSpace exposes size() method; tests also expect expand() to return updated space while implementation returns None.
Test PermeableAgent adds omega to numeric capability even though environment.extract_constraints returns ConstraintSignal object.
All test Environment(difficulty=...) constructions conflict with frozen Environment signature requiring state.
Frozen repository has test source but no GitHub Actions run/status record or persisted test report establishing execution/pass/failure at the frozen head.
